note: Toolbar and dialog action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor commands (e.g., New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Find, Replace, Print, Help, Close, OK, Cancel)
Toolbar and dialog view toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for UI state (e.g., Sidebar, Statusbar, Fullscreen, Show Line Numbers)
Preferences dialog checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor settings (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, Highlight Current Line, Auto Indent)
Preferences dialog radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for mutually exclusive settings (e.g., Tab size, Indentation type, Line wrap mode)
Preferences dialog and toolbar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for setting names, descriptions, and button tooltips
